user.title: Prix Énergie FR
user.description: Electricity, gas and water prices for the Energy dashboard.

electricity.title: Electricity
electricity.description: Regulated tariff (Tarif Bleu, CRE open data on data.gouv.fr) or your own contract prices (all taxes included).

data_description.hc_schedule: Comma separated ranges, e.g. 22:00-06:00 or 02:00-07:00, 13:00-16:00 (see your bill or Enedis).
data_description.hc_entity: Entity telling when off-peak is active (teleinfo PTEC/LTARF, binary sensor...). Takes precedence over the hours above.
data_description.elec_custom_subscription: Only used with your own prices.

gas.title: Natural gas
gas.description: CRE gas reference price (GRDF area, updated monthly) or your own contract prices (all taxes included).

data_description.gas_kwh_per_m3: Printed on your gas bill (≈ 10.5–11.5). Used for the €/m³ sensor.
data_description.gas_custom_subscription: Only used with your own prices.

water.title: Water
water.description: No national open data source is reliable enough: enter the price on your water bill (all taxes included, drinking water + sewage).

data_description.water_price_m3: Total price per m³ on your bill.
